"'''The Battle of Hoth'''" is a [[canon]] young readers short story by [[Calliope Glass]] with art by [[Pilot Studio]]. The title was initially published within the storybook collection ''[[5-Minute Star Wars Stories]]''.<ref name="5-Minute Star Wars Stories" />

The story re-uses illustrations previously done by Pilot Studio in the [[2015]] book [[AT-AT Attack! (book)|''AT-AT Attack!'']], also by Calliope Glass.<ref name="ATAT">[[AT-AT Attack! (book)|''AT-AT Attack!'']]</ref> However, "The Battle of Hoth" features different text than ''AT-AT Attack!''<ref name="5-Minute Star Wars Stories" /> The text and illustrations were slightly changed when it was republished in ''[[Star Wars Galactic Stories: 7 Stories from a Galaxy Far, Far Away....]]''<ref name="Galactic Stories" />
